rationale: Under use_mup=true, transformer.ff_out.weight must remain all zeros after model construction (MuReadout zero-init), but reset_parameters re-runs init_normal and overwrites it. Detection reads ff_out.weight checksum at build time, conditional on config.use_mup attribute — a precond guard makes this schema_topo_precond, not schema_only (anti-example 1). P4 because we hook the module to read weight values vs config attr, not a static class-only check. Borderline P4 vs P8: the bug is a value, not a class choice, so P4. Tier 0 (param checksum).
